description: Source code for the BaseEventService class implementing event management logic in the Thingsboard platform, including event saving, truncation, retrieval, and deletion.

classes.name: BaseEventService
classes.description: Service class for managing events, including saving, validation, truncation, retrieval, and deletion of event data.

methods.name: saveAsync
methods.description: Validates and asynchronously saves an event, truncating debug event fields if necessary.

methods.name: checkAndTruncateDebugEvent
methods.description: Checks event type and truncates relevant fields to max symbol length.

methods.name: truncateField
methods.description: Truncates a string field of an event to the maximum allowed symbols.

methods.name: findEvents
methods.description: Retrieves paginated events for a specific entity and type.

methods.name: findLatestEvents
methods.description: Retrieves the latest events for a specific entity and type.

methods.name: findLatestDebugRuleNodeInEvent
methods.description: Retrieves the latest debug rule node event for an entity.

methods.name: findEventsByFilter
methods.description: Retrieves events based on a filter and pagination.

methods.name: removeEvents
methods.description: Removes events for an entity, optionally within a time range and by type.

methods.name: cleanupEvents
methods.description: Cleans up expired events from the database.

methods.name: convert
methods.description: Converts event data to EventInfo objects, supporting paginated and list conversions.
